description: She wears a plum floor-length gown over an ivory underdress, with a low square neckline, structured bodice, elbow sleeves and rich gold geometric embroidered borders. Jewelled shoulder brooches and a matching waist clasp fasten the garment; a cream-gold embroidered wrap rests along the forearms and hangs at both sides. A small ring and embroidered plum-gold shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
